verdict.rationale: IP India publishes an Electronic Register of Patent Agents, a list of IP Mitras (patent facilitators) under the SIPP scheme, and a Facilitators-Designs page. Together these show a sanctioned rail of registered agents and facilitators who can act for applicants. The evidence is only page titles, though, with no documentation of how an agent is authorized to act for a company. missing for 10: documentation of the authorization or power-of-attorney mechanism, the scope of what agents and facilitators may do on a company's behalf, coverage for trademark and GI agents, and independent corroboration.
